title: 第13章  两颗水果糖
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

眼下这天气冷得伸不出手，想让面团发起来，李阳也只能靠空间。

空间里那个加工作坊，虽说干不了多精细的活，可发面这种糙活儿还是能接的。

不光是发老面，往后要是想酿点酒、淋些酱油醋、晒几坛豆瓣酱，但凡用得着发酵的，全可以扔进作坊里伺候着。

把面团挪进作坊发上，李阳赶紧蹲到灶坑前头生火，又把大锅水坐上。

家里有三屉大蒸笼，都刷洗得干干净净，码在灶台边上随时候着。

忙忙叨叨一个来钟头，十斤面粉见了底。蒸出来一百五十个白胖白胖的大馒头，一个挨一个，宣腾腾的。

麦香味直往鼻子里钻。李阳正巧没吃晌午饭，趁着刚出锅的热乎劲，一口气嚼了六个。

“得劲！”肚皮鼓起来了，李阳长长地吐了口气。

余下的馒头全挪进了空间仓库里。啥时候想吃，伸手就能掏出来。

歇了一袋烟的功夫，李阳又撅着腚忙上了。

袋子里还剩十五斤面粉。他匀出十斤来使，扣下五斤压箱底。

又从空间里掏了几棵大白菜和一把韭菜，拿猪油调了馅子，包了两样吃食。

白菜馅的蒸成大包子，拢共五十个。

饺子做了两样馅，一样白菜猪肉，一样韭菜鸡蛋，各包了一两百个。

饺子下了锅煮透，捞出来盛进两只大木桶里，连包子一块儿全收进了空间。

打今儿往后，吃食这块就再不用犯愁了。

再过些日子，空间里的小鸡崽子满地跑，肥猪攒够了一窝，这小日子就更有滋味了。

就算一时半会儿寻不着牛羊，李阳也不会急得上火，慢慢踅摸着呗。

日子不经混，一眨眼天就擦黑了。

外头黑了咕咚的，李阳嚼了几个包子垫了肚子，刚把灶房里里外外拾掇干净，耳朵就支棱起来了——有脚步声。

“是秦京茹那丫头。”李阳心里有数了。

秦京茹走道的动静，他闭着眼都能听出来。一蹦一跳的，透着一股子欢实劲儿。

他没往外迎，不紧不慢地倒了盆热水，坐下泡脚，等着秦京茹自个儿进门。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's so cold right now that he can't stretch out his hands. If he wants the dough to rise, Li Yang can only rely on space.

Although the processing workshop in the space can't do much fine work, it can still handle rough work like making dough.

Not only for making old noodles, if you want to brew some wine, pour some soy sauce and vinegar, dry some jars of bean paste, anything that needs fermentation, you can throw it into the workshop and wait for it.

After moving the dough into the workshop, Li Yang quickly squatted in front of the stove to light a fire and put a large pot of water on it.

There are three large drawers of steamers at home. They are all cleaned and kept beside the stove at all times.

After an hour of busy talking, the ten kilograms of flour have bottomed out.One hundred and fifty big white and fat steamed buns were steamed, one next to the other, and they were full of steam.

The smell of wheat penetrates straight into the nose.Li Yang happened to have missed lunch, so he took advantage of the heat from the pot and chewed six of them in one breath.

"Good luck!" Li Yang let out a long breath as his belly bulged.

The remaining steamed buns were all moved into the space warehouse.Whenever you want to eat, you can just reach out and take it out.

After taking a break from smoking a pack of cigarettes, Li Yang got busy again, pouting his butt.

There are fifteen pounds of flour left in the bag.He evenly distributed ten kilograms, took five kilograms and pressed them to the bottom of the box.

I took out a few cabbages and a handful of leeks from the space, mixed the stuffing with lard, and made two kinds of food.

The stuffed cabbage is steamed into large buns, fifty in total.

Two kinds of fillings were made for the dumplings, one with cabbage and pork, the other with leeks and eggs, each containing one or two hundred pieces.

The dumplings were boiled thoroughly in the pot, taken out and put into two large wooden barrels, and the buns and buns were all put into the space.

From now on, I won’t have to worry about food anymore.

In a few days, the chickens will be running all over the space, and the fat pigs will have a nest, and these little days will be even more interesting.

Even if he couldn't find the cattle or sheep for a while, Li Yang wouldn't get angry and would just wander around slowly.

The days go by without any hesitation, and the sky turns dark in the blink of an eye.

It was dark and noisy outside. Li Yang chewed a few steamed buns to cushion his stomach. As soon as he cleaned up the inside and outside of the kitchen, his ears started to prick up - there was the sound of footsteps.

"It's that girl Qin Jingru." Li Yang knew it.

He could hear the movement of Qin Jingru in the aisle with his eyes closed.Jumping and jumping, there is a sense of joy.

He didn't go out to greet her, but poured a basin of hot water slowly, sat down and soaked his feet, waiting for Qin Jingru to come in on her own.
